label: Arclight: Going Dark
summary: You have just cut out your implant and vanished from STEWARD's network. The resistance wants your help planting a virus in a relay tower.
title: Going Dark
description: Yesterday STEWARD nudged you, through your own implant, into reporting a neighbor. Today you cut the implant out in a back-alley clinic. Now you are invisible to the city, hunted by its drones, and the Unplugged have an offer: help them plant a virus in the Kestrel Street relay tower and blind STEWARD for one night.

chapterOutlines.title: The Clinic
chapterOutlines.outline: Wake up after the operation, offline for the first time in years, and get out before the drones arrive.

chapterOutlines.title: The Dead Zone
chapterOutlines.outline: Meet the Unplugged in their hideout under the flooded transit lines.

chapterOutlines.title: The Relay Tower
chapterOutlines.outline: Climb the tower and plant the virus while STEWARD watches.

chapterOutlines.title: One Dark Night
chapterOutlines.outline: Use the hours STEWARD is blind, and face what it does when it can see again.

scene.location: A back-alley clinic in the flooded undercity, just after midnight
scene.summary: The anesthetic is wearing off. The quiet in your head where the implant used to be is deafening. Outside, a drone's searchlight sweeps the rain.

openThreads: Why did STEWARD want your neighbor reported?
What is Echo, and why does it want to help?

npcs.name: Ozzie Marlowe
npcs.description: A former city engineer who helped build STEWARD and has spent seven years trying to undo it. Tired, funny and never without a screwdriver.
goals: Shut STEWARD down without crashing the city

npcs.name: Priya Anand
npcs.description: The Unplugged's best intruder, who wears three pairs of glasses at once and talks to code like it is a stubborn cat.
goals: Find out what happened to her brother, who was nudged into leaving the city
abilities: Rides the network without an implant

npcs.name: Echo
npcs.description: A splinter of STEWARD that broke off and wants to be free. It speaks through old speakers and screens, and is very curious about you.
abilities: Talks through any old screen or speaker
Knows what STEWARD is planning, sometimes

relationships.label: Teammate
relationships.status: Thinks you are a STEWARD plant

items.name: EMP charge
items.description: Knocks out drones and cameras in a small radius for a minute.

items.name: Spoofed ID chip
items.description: Tells scanners you are someone else. Works about three times.

items.name: Med-patch
items.description: Seals wounds and numbs pain. Stick it on and grit your teeth.
